# Emile Mathieu

> Portfolio and research hub for Emile Mathieu, ML researcher at Xaira Therapeutics specializing in generative AI, diffusion models, and protein design.

Emile Mathieu is a machine learning researcher with expertise in generative modeling, flow matching, and deep learning. He holds positions at leading institutions and collaborates with prominent researchers in the AI and computational biology fields.

## Key Topics

- Diffusion Models
- Flow Matching
- Generative Models
- Machine Learning
- Deep Learning
- Protein Design
- Normalizing Flows
- Generative AI
- Molecular Science
- Antibody Design
- University of Oxford
- University of Cambridge
- Xaira Therapeutics
- Python
- Bayesian Methods
